## Why This Is Asked
Tests cross-platform native module design for real-time data fusion, multi-threading, and RN bridging; evaluates handling of calibration, privacy, and power in AR scenarios.

## Key Concepts
- TurboModules and JSI integration
- Real-time data pipelines at 90–120 Hz
- Threading models and worker queues
- Backpressure via ring buffers
- Pose calibration and privacy controls

```javascript
// Minimal usage sketch
import {NativeModules} from 'react-native';
const PoseStream = NativeModules.ARPoseStream;
PoseStream.startPoseStream({frequency:120, calibrate:true});
PoseStream.onPose((p)=>{ /* update overlay */ });
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test jitter under thermal throttling?
- How to handle device orientation and AR session restarts?
